info.title: kr0n Control Plane & Auth API
info.description: Enterprise multi-tenant control plane API for identity, RBAC, workspaces, API keys, and GitHub integrations.

post.description: Creates a new user profile with email, password, and display name. If email verification is enabled, an unverified account is created and an activation code is sent.
Authenticates user credentials. Upon success, issues access_token and refresh_token strictly via HttpOnly SameSite cookies; tokens are omitted from the JSON response body to prevent XSS.
Rotates session tokens using the HttpOnly refresh_token cookie and returns updated access_token and refresh_token cookies. No request body is required.
Revokes the active session, destroys session state in Redis/Postgres, and clears access_token and refresh_token cookies via Set-Cookie.

get.description: Retrieves all active device and browser sessions for the authenticated user, including client IP, user agent, and last active timestamp.

delete.description: Immediately terminates a specific session by its session ID belonging to the authenticated user, invalidating any token refresh attempts.

get.description: Returns active public Ed25519 signing keys formatted according to RFC 7517. Used by the API Gateway, satellite services, and third-party verifiers.
Returns profile information, email verification status, and organization membership details for the authenticated user.

post.description: Consumes an email verification token received via email and upgrades the account to verified status.
Generates a fresh email verification token and dispatches an activation email if the account exists and is unverified.
Initiates a self-service password reset flow. If the email is registered, a time-limited secure reset link is emailed.
Consumes a valid password reset token and updates the user's password. Revokes all existing user sessions across devices.
Verifies the current password and changes it to the new password for the authenticated caller. Revokes all other active sessions.

get.description: Generates an RFC 7636 PKCE challenge and HMAC-signed state token, returning the GitHub authorization URL for the browser to redirect to.
Exchanges the authorization code and PKCE code verifier with GitHub, links or provisions the user account, and returns session tokens.

get.description: Generates an RFC 7636 PKCE challenge and state token, returning the Google authorization URL for the browser to redirect to.
Exchanges the authorization code and PKCE code verifier with Google, links or provisions the user account, and returns session tokens.

get.description: Retrieves all organizations in which the authenticated caller is a member, admin, or owner.

post.description: Provisions a new multi-tenant organization workspace with a unique slug and designates the authenticated caller as the Owner.

get.description: Returns organization metadata, slug, name, and timestamps by ID. Caller must belong to the organization.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an organization and cascades removal across members, tokens, and resources. Requires Owner role.

patch.description: Modifies organization display name or metadata. Requires `org:write` permission.

get.description: Returns the platform RBAC role catalog (e.g. Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer) with their granular permission capabilities.
Retrieves all members within an organization workspace, including user email, display name, and assigned role.

post.description: Adds an existing registered user directly to the organization workspace with the specified role. Requires `members:write`.

delete.description: Removes a member from the organization workspace, revoking all organization-scoped permissions. Requires `members:delete`.

patch.description: Promotes or demotes an existing member's role within the organization. Requires `members:write`.

post.description: Generates an invitation token to invite an email address into the organization workspace under a specified role. Requires `invites:write`.
Consumes an invitation token and attaches the authenticated user to the organization with the invite's designated role.

delete.description: Invalidates a pending invitation token, preventing it from being accepted. Requires `invites:delete`.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for all active Personal Access Tokens created for the organization, including name, prefix, scopes, and expiration. Requires `tokens:read`.

post.description: Provisions an org-scoped API token (`kr0n_pat_...`) with custom permissions and optional expiration. The raw token is returned only once upon creation. Requires `tokens:write`.

delete.description: Immediately revokes an API token, deactivating programmatic access for CI/CD or automation clients. Requires `tokens:delete`.

get.description: Queries the immutable append-only audit log for security, authentication, and administrative actions within the organization. Requires `audit:read`.
